_comment: Summon banners (V, 2026-10-03): a banner puts a summon pool and some featured monsters in the spotlight, for a while, and shows the event bonus on cosmetic points. A banner only DISPLAYS: it never changes the odds of the pool (V's drop rule: a broader pool never makes a rare outcome easier than its own scroll). `event` ties a banner to a live event (it shows while the event runs); without `event` it is permanent. x10 and x100 summons use the same pool. PLACEHOLDER banners.
